'''2022 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event in Seattle, Washington, 8–10 April 2022. [[Jeff Lavigne]] finished 1st in the Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-endor-grand-prix/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Dates:''' 8–10 April 2022
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80665 forum]
